verdict.rationale: Replit says you can describe a project and have it write production-ready code that becomes a working app ([replit-docs-2], [replit-docs-1]). Its Agent also provisions backend pieces like auth and a database with dev/prod environments ([replit-docs-13], [replit-docs-28]), and can turn a design frame into a functional website ([replit-docs-15]). The docs, however, show the database being added as a follow-up step rather than in one combined prompt. Community opinion of the tool is mixed ([replit-comm-6], [replit-comm-7]), but no report concretely shows full-stack generation failing. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that one prompt produces both UI and server/API logic together, detailed docs on what backend code Agent generates, and independent hands-on corroboration of full-stack output.
